description: Engage opportunities: recent LinkedIn posts by people in the user's OWN network (or at their target accounts) about a company with a fresh Fundz event, each with why it matched, the post link, a suggested DM and comment in the user's voice, and its status (delivered, contacted, replied, booked). Same list as app.fundz.net/engage. Needs Engage set up (LinkedIn connections uploaded). Use with get_daily_leads (icp: "all") for one deduplicated account list across every ICP plus warm network paths. Never send a DM or comment for the user; show the draft and let them post it.

days.description: How far back, in days (default 14, max 90).

status.description: "open" (default) = not yet contacted or dismissed; "all" includes contacted, replied, booked and dismissed.

name: get_engage_opportunities
title: Get Engage network opportunities
